sentences.text: Ashish Jain vs Sonam Jain on 12 August, 2024

In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition (Criminal) No 360 of 2022
 Ashish Jain ... P
 Versus
 Sonam Jain and Others ... R
 Order
1
The Transfer Petition was listed before the Supreme Court Special Lok Adalat on 30 July 2024.
2 Parties have arrived at a settlement on 29 April 2024.
However, since the payment of permanent alimony was to be made to the first respondent, the proceedings were directed to be listed before the regular Court.
3 Out of the permanent alimony of Rs 23 lakhs, an amount of Rs 8 lakhs has already been paid.
A demand draft of Rs 5 lakhs has been handed over in the course of the proceedings to the counsel for the first respondent.

4 Counsel for the petitioner tenders an undertaking on behalf of the petitioner that the remaining amount of Rs 10 lakhs is being transferred to the bank account of the first respondent by electronic transfer of funds during the course of the day.
6 Parties have resided separately since 2018.

Parties have one son, who is about Reason:
seven years of age.
The settlement envisages that the custody of the son will be with the first respondent.
This would be in the interest of the minor.
7 In view of the settlement, there shall be a decree for divorce by mutual consent in the exercise of the jurisdiction of this Court under Article 142 of the Constitution.

8 The following proceedings by and between the parties shall stand quashed or, as the case may be,
disposed of:

(i) Misc. Case No. 1226 of 2018 under Section 12 of DV Act, 2005  Sonam Jain vs.
Ashish Jain & Others pending before the Court of JMFC, Gwalior Madhya Pradesh.
